sch: Bio stub -- Don Balón 'A todo crack' feature (~Nov 1999 issue), not video-graded. Danish winger/forward, primarily left flank per the article's own text (listed as 'Delantero' in the magazine's own fact box, kept as stated). Born in Nuuk, Greenland. Youth: Thisted FC; senior: Aalborg Boldspilklub (AaB) 1994-98, Ajax 1998-present (contract through 2003). Article covers his imminent transfer to Chelsea under Claudio Ranieri for a reported 12.5M fee -- still an Ajax player as of this issue. 14 Denmark caps at time of writing, debut 27 March 1999, first international goal vs San Marino (Euro 2000 qualifying). Height 1.87m, weight 83kg. MP/MIN/G/A/CRDY left at 0 -- no season stats table in this source.

Real season stats -- Universidad de Chile 'Campeón 2000' special-edition fascicle player card. 1999: 29 apps, 2 goals for U. de Chile (his only pro season shown; debut year). Primarily left-back per the card's own text, deployed at various points as libero and left-sided midfielder -- kept as DF (his primary/most common role per source) with the midfield/libero versatility disclosed here rather than folded into pos. Height 1.81m, weight 76kg. International: debuted for Chile 29 January 2000 (2-1 loss vs USA, Coquimbo), 2 caps total at time of publication -- so this fascicle was assembled after that debut, placing its actual publication in early-to-mid 2000, though the season data itself covers 1999 (Chilean football runs a single-calendar-year season). No club titles listed as individual, but collective: Campeonato chileno (1999, 2000), Torneo de Apertura (2000).

Real season stats -- Universidad de Chile 'Campeón 2000' special-edition fascicle player card. 1999: 42 apps, 4 goals for U. de Chile (most recent season in the card's own year-by-year table; prior seasons per that table: 1996 Audax Italiano 3 apps/0 goals, 1997 Audax Italiano 24 apps/2 goals, 1998 U. de Chile 15 apps/1 goal -- not added as separate rows here, this entry covers the 1999 season only, matching how this database otherwise tracks one current-season row per source snapshot). Versatile defender -- left-back and center-back per the card's text and its own individual honours (Mejor lateral izquierdo 1996, Mejor zaguero central 1999); kept as DF. Height 1.84m, weight 75kg. International: debut for Chile 31 January 1993 vs Iran (Copa Carlsberg, Hong Kong), 5 official caps at time of publication. Individual titles: Mejor lateral izquierdo 1996, Jugador revelación 1996, Mejor zaguero central 1999. Collective: Campeonato chileno (1999, 2000), Torneo de Apertura (1998, 2000), Bronze medal at the Sydney Olympics. NOTE: a separate Don Balón squad-list source (same batch, ~Nov 1999) prints his DOB as 26 May 1978, two weeks off this card's own '6 de mayo de 1978' -- used this dedicated club fact-sheet's date as primary since it is the more detailed, player-specific source; flagged here for transparency.
